doc.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1978-Fall Transcript

title: New album, live recording at Tipitina's, bar named for his song
summary: A new album will probably be recorded in New Orleans; a live Tipitina's album is coming; he likes having a bar named after his song.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: And you are working on a new album. All the time I'll be working on it. Do you think you'll record that here in New Orleans or? I think I will.
Yeah, do you think it'll be recorded here? All this is left up to me in the castle. I don't worry about the business end of the situation. I just like to get the groups in.
We recorded an album on Marty's right, Tipitina's. Uh huh. That will be coming out within the next year.
it's live, it's in the team.
Put out live albums or studio albums, live.
How do you like having a bar named after one of your songs?
Oh, it makes you feel great. We could get a few more, you know. Then we could really support the group, you know.
